title: Internet Archive Scraper — Core Pipeline
goal: Build a working Internet Archive scraper that discovers, fetches, and stores trending content metadata for the TikTok Content Agent pipeline. By end of sprint: scraper runs locally on vault, outputs structured JSON to Supabase, passes Guardiola review. Fetch queries are driven by the 30 ranked viral topics from viral_agent_report_EN.md.

This file encodes all 30 ranked topics as typed constants. The scraper runner will iterate these to drive all IA search queries.

Exports:
```typescript
export type MediaType = 'movies' | 'audio' | 'texts' | 'image';
export type ViralTrigger = 'awe' | 'shock' | 'amusement' | 'inspiration' | 'nostalgia' | 'curiosity' | 'satisfaction' | 'debate';
export type Platform = 'tiktok' | 'youtube_shorts' | 'instagram_reels';

export interface TopicConfig {
  id: string;                    // e.g. 'T01', 'T02'
  rank: number;                  // 1–30 from the report
  name: string;                  // e.g. 'Wildlife & Animal Predator/Prey Encounters'
  triggers: ViralTrigger[];      // emotional triggers from the report
  ia_queries: string[];          // 2–4 specific IA search query strings
  mediatype: MediaType;          // primary mediatype for IA filter
  ia_collection?: string;        // optional IA collection filter (e.g. 'prelinger')
  music_genre: string;           // from the report
  caption_strategy: string;      // one-line caption strategy from the report
  platform_priority: Platform[]; // ordered: best platform first
  min_score?: number;            // override default 30 if this topic needs higher bar
}

export const VIRAL_TOPICS: TopicConfig[];
export const TOP_10_TOPICS: TopicConfig[];  // VIRAL_TOPICS.slice(0, 10)
```

Map all 30 topics from the report. For ia_queries, translate each topic into 2–4 precise Internet Archive search strings. Examples:
- T01 Wildlife: ['wildlife predator prey attack', 'cheetah lion hunt nature', 'animal attack footage']
- T02 Space/NASA: ['NASA space footage rocket launch', 'hubble james webb telescope', 'ISS earth timelapse']
- T03 Historical: ['historical newsreel 1900s 1950s', 'world war II footage archive', 'moon landing apollo']
- T05 Cartoons: ['charlie chaplin buster keaton', 'betty boop felix cat animation public domain', 'fleischer studios']
- T12 Slapstick: ['slapstick comedy vintage fails', 'harold lloyd charlie chaplin comedy']
- T18 Vintage Ads: use ia_collection: 'prelinger' with queries ['vintage advertisement 1950s', 'commercial educational film retro']

For every topic from the report, derive queries that will actually return results on archive.org/advancedsearch.php.

Max 200 lines. No external deps. Pure typed constants — no logic.

tasks.description: Content scorer — rank IA items by TikTok potential
tasks.context:
Create /Users/tarekmnif/kognai/workspace/tools/ia-scraper/src/content-scorer.ts

Scores Internet Archive items by their potential as TikTok content source material.
The scoring is informed by the viral trigger framework in viral_agent_report_EN.md (Section A + B).

Exports:
```typescript
export interface ScoredItem extends IAItem {
  score: number;          // 0-100, higher = better TikTok potential
  score_breakdown: {
    virality: number;     // based on downloads/views (0-40 pts)
    recency: number;      // date proximity to today (0-25 pts)
    richness: number;     // has description + subject tags (0-20 pts)
    media_bonus: number;  // videos score higher (0-15 pts)
  };
  disqualified: boolean;  // true if fails hard rules
  disqualify_reason?: string;
}

export function scoreItem(item: IAItem): ScoredItem;
export function rankItems(items: IAItem[]): ScoredItem[];
```

Scoring logic:
- virality: log10(max(downloads ?? 0, views ?? 0, 1)) / log10(1000000) * 40 — capped at 40
- recency: if publicdate within 30 days → 25pts, 90 days → 15pts, 1yr → 5pts, older → 0pts
- richness: +10 if description exists (>50 chars), +10 if subject has >= 3 tags
- media_bonus: mediatype==='movies' → 15pts, 'audio' → 10pts, others → 0pts

Disqualification rules (disqualified=true):
- mediatype === 'texts' AND no visual description
- title contains 'test' or 'sample' or 'placeholder' (case-insensitive)
- downloads === 0 AND views === 0 AND publicdate older than 1 year

rankItems: filter disqualified=false, sort by score desc, return top 50.

Max 80 lines. No external deps.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: rankItems on 20 mixed items returns sorted array with score_breakdown populated, disqualified items excluded

Create /Users/tarekmnif/kognai/workspace/tools/ia-scraper/src/storage.ts

Persists scored IA items to Supabase. Uses the SUPABASE_URL and SUPABASE_ANON_KEY from ~/kognai/.env.

Exports:
```typescript
export interface StoredItem extends ScoredItem {
  id?: string;            // Supabase UUID (set after insert)
  scraped_at: string;     // ISO timestamp
  sprint_id: string;      // e.g. 'sprint-052'
  used_in_tiktok: boolean; // default false
}

export async function upsertItems(items: ScoredItem[], sprintId: string): Promise<{ inserted: number; skipped: number }>;
export async function getTopUnused(limit?: number): Promise<StoredItem[]>;
export async function markUsed(identifier: string): Promise<void>;
```

Supabase table schema (create via migration if not exists):
```sql
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ia_content (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  identifier TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,
  title TEXT NOT NULL,
  description TEXT,
  mediatype TEXT NOT NULL,
  subject JSONB,
  creator TEXT,
  source_url TEXT NOT NULL,
  downloads INT,
  views INT,
  score FLOAT NOT NULL,
  score_breakdown JSONB NOT NULL,
  topic_id TEXT,
  scraped_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
  sprint_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  used_in_tiktok BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
  publicdate TIMESTAMPTZ
);
```

Note: table now includes topic_id column to track which viral topic sourced each item.

upsertItems: INSERT ... ON CONFLICT (identifier) DO UPDATE SET score=EXCLUDED.score, topic_id=EXCLUDED.topic_id, scraped_at=NOW()
getTopUnused: SELECT where used_in_tiktok=false ORDER BY score DESC LIMIT {limit ?? 20}
markUsed: UPDATE SET used_in_tiktok=true WHERE identifier={id}

Load SUPABASE_URL and SUPABASE_ANON_KEY from process.env (dotenv loaded by runner).
Use @supabase/supabase-js v2. Max 100 lines.
